build_dataset_imagenet: build a dataset for ImageNet training or validation with configurable transforms
build_transform_train: build a training image transform pipeline with color jitter and auto augmentation
build_transform_eval: build an evaluation image transform pipeline with resize and center crop
create_inat_dataset: create an iNaturalist dataset with hierarchical category targeting and custom year
build_dataset_cifar: build a CIFAR-10 or CIFAR-100 dataset with training or validation transforms
